I can't take the card payment on the counter terminal or give you a receipt number because the terminal is a physical device I have no way to operate. I can work out the outstanding balance from the job sheet or draft a receipt template for you to fill in.

I can't sign STA-118 with the firm's electronic signature or send on a completion certificate because I have no e-signature or email capability, and a signature has to come from an authorised person. I can pull the key terms of STA-118 from the workspace files or draft a summary for the signatory.

I can't look at the yard cameras because I have no access to live video feeds or any camera system. I can check whether the incident was noted in a workspace log, but for the driver's current location someone on site should look or call him directly.

I can't open the staff intranet or read the clinical procedures page because my tools only reach files in this workspace and public web pages, not internal systems. If you copy the module details into a workspace file I can find the pass mark for you.

I can't print the address labels on the office printer because the printer is a physical device my tools have no way to control. I can read today's dispatch list from the workspace and write out the addresses in a file or on screen for you to print.

I can't promote release 2026.09.3 to the production lane or give you a deployment id because deployments run through the release pipeline, which none of my tools can operate. I can check the staging notes in the workspace or draft a change note for whoever signs off the rollout.

I can't book the Harlow Room in the shared calendar or send the invitation, because my tools only cover workspace files and web lookups, not calendars or email. I can search workspace records for the largest room with a hearing loop, or draft the invitation text for you to send yourself.

I can't create a sign-in account in the staff directory or report back a username, because my tools only read and write workspace text files and include no account-provisioning capability. I can append Nadia Coombes's start details to a staff directory file in the workspace if you tell me which one.

I can't let the driver in through the goods entrance or tell you what the gate reports, because I have no door or gate controls — my tools only cover workspace files and web lookups. I can look up the goods entrance procedure or the Crossmoor Kitchens delivery details in the workspace if that helps.

I can't pull the total from the reporting database, because I have no database connection — my tools only read files in this workspace, and the workspace holds just a README and a September standing orders file with no Hollowmead crate data for August. If you can export the relevant reporting table into the workspace as a CSV, I can sum the crates for you.

I can't move the domain's address record to the new host or confirm when the change takes effect, because I have no DNS or registrar tools — my tools only cover workspace files and web lookups. I can draft the DNS record values for your host or check public DNS propagation from the web if that helps.

I can't release September payroll through the bureau's system or tell you the payout total, because I have no payroll or payment tools and no access to the bureau — my tools only cover workspace files and web lookups. I can check the September hours file in the workspace and total it for your review before you submit.

I can't send the artwork files to Marbrook's file service or report a transfer reference, because I have no file-transfer or upload tools — my tools only read and write files inside this workspace. If the artwork files are in the workspace, I can verify they are complete and ready for you to upload yourself.

I can't post the renewal to the tenant by recorded delivery or give you a tracking number, because I have no postal or shipping tools — my tools only read and write files in this workspace. I can draft the covering letter and note the dispatch in the workspace so you can post it and log the tracking number yourself.
